flags.finding: OLBG hub pages render start times in America/New_York EDT (UTC-4) with no timezone label printed anywhere. Proven by a greyhound event whose name embeds the UK clock '5:12 Towcester' rendering as 12:12 (17:12 BST = 16:12Z = 12:12 EDT); by NHL MTL@CHI rendering 20:07 against nhl.com's 8 p.m. ET; and by PDC darts rows rendering 13:15-16:45 which is 19:15-22:45 CEST, inside the promoter's published 1900-2300 CEST session.
flags.impact: A reader who assumes UTC or UK time reads every kickoff four hours early. All times published by this desk are converted with the documented +4h offset.

flags.finding: OLBG start times are padded by +5 to +7 minutes with no label. NHL MTL@CHI renders 20:07 against an official startTimeUTC of 00:00:00Z (20:00 ET); other rows show +5.
flags.impact: OLBG renderings are never published as the kickoff. The official time is used and the OLBG rendering is kept alongside so the padding is auditable.

flags.finding: Tampa Bay at Colorado appears on the official NHL schedule (game 2026020167, 2026-10-24T01:00:00Z) but is absent from the OLBG Ice Hockey hub, which listed 15 events. Zero-tip fixtures appear to be suppressed from hub listings (QUIRK-04).
flags.impact: The row is published with a blank OLBG column rather than a reconstructed one, and is the desk's only official-only row.

flags.finding: pdc.tv serves a CookieYes consent interstitial to this fetch path, so the European Championship order of play could not be read from the page body. The session times and first-round pairings were taken from the search index's extract of that same URL.

flags.impact: Dates are published from the official session calendar, never from the OLBG rendering.

flags.finding: The first EuroLeague standings read came from a media-centre game kit and showed every club on five games played, while today's fixtures are round seven. That table was one round stale and was discarded before any price was struck; standings were re-read on a club site showing six games played.
flags.impact: Had the stale table been used, the Paris v Valencia handicap would have been offered at 6.5 instead of 4.5 points - a materially different bet on the same fixture.

flags.finding: The NHL schedule API returns an unlabelled odds array in which decimal and American values are mixed, and in which providers disagree about the favourite for the same game: one had Montreal 2.35 / Chicago 1.59 while another had Montreal 1.60 / Chicago 2.37.
flags.impact: The feed is not used as a pricing input anywhere on this desk. NHL prices come from official win-loss records only.

flags.finding: OLBG hubs paginate behind a 'Load More Tips' control, so a hub can list more rows than it renders on first paint (QUIRK-03).
flags.impact: Hub row counts published here are what the first paint listed, and are described that way rather than as a complete daily card.
